name: Neo-Brutalist
summary: A contemporary design aesthetic reviving brutalist principles with modern materials, featuring raw concrete, bold geometry, and functional honesty.
description: Neo-Brutalism is a contemporary design aesthetic that revives brutalist principles with modern materials and sensibilities. It features raw concrete, bold geometric forms, functional honesty, and a rejection of decorative excess. The aesthetic has gained traction in web design, architecture, and graphic design, often combining brutalist forms with contemporary color palettes and digital media.
